scope.publisherSupply: chain-key-only: one sealed chain member per render and one item wrap at the render's own coordinate; no sealed content key; no period-key member
steps: thirteen renders: 12:00 through 14:15 (the prefix), 14:30, 11:45 and next-day 00:00
read 14:15 at issuer time 14:20: policy authorizes the prefix independently and selects zero future periods; the issuer returns the chain key at 14:15
read 12:00 through 14:00: each opens from the retained chain key with no issuer call
try 14:30, 11:45 and next-day 00:00 with no unlock: each stays missing and unopened; nothing retained changes

discovery: a leaf root found by discoverFixturePackageRoots (js/test-tools/claim-index.js); verification/fixtures/v1/, v1/profiles/ and v1/profiles/dca-profile-chain-keys/ are path segments, not packages

consumers.description: replays the recorded markup through the real Browser and IssuerServer, holds the assertions, and checks the recorded bytes against the witness with stock WebCrypto
tests the package check: membership, checksums, regeneration and refusals
membership both ways, per-member sha256 and a fresh recording; writes nothing

limitations: All claim decisions are incomplete; this package decides no claim.
It is regression and provenance evidence for the JavaScript issuer and client, not independent conformance.
The publisher is not replayed: renders are recorded markup, and ES256 signatures are retained values, not reproducible bytes.
One geometry, one window, one cutoff, one issuer, direct transport and ECDH-P256 envelopes only; no client-bound transport and no rival generation.
